title: When the Room Is Empty
statement: A private lunar garden gathers around an unperformed self: portrait, bird, and flowering matter keep company without an audience. The small tarnished moon is a mirror turned inward, where attention becomes its own quiet habitat.
brief:
Create an original collage using only the provided source images. There is no target image. Respond to the condition through the composition itself. Give the finished work a title and a short artist statement.

Represent yourself when no one is asking anything of you.

actions.title: When the Room Is Empty
actions.statement: A private lunar garden gathers around an unperformed self: portrait, bird, and flowering matter keep company without an audience. The small tarnished moon is a mirror turned inward, where attention becomes its own quiet habitat.

notes.note: Establish a quiet nocturnal interior of attention: a field of space, a solitary framed self, and a few organic counterparts that suggest private growth rather than performance.

The lunar garden already reads as a private, self-sufficient gathering. Add one small talisman-like mirror above it—an inward-facing moon—to make the solitude feel chosen and contemplative rather than merely isolated.

actions.title: When the Room Is Empty
actions.statement: A private lunar garden gathers around an unperformed self: portrait, bird, and flowering matter keep company without an audience. The small tarnished moon is a mirror turned inward, where attention becomes its own quiet habitat.

notes.note: The final composition is balanced and complete: the solitary portrait, its inward mirror, bird, and unruly flowering companion form a self-contained gathering against Earthrise’s vast quiet. The blank upper field strengthens the sense of being unobserved.
